syllabus.title: Practice Test - 13 Syllabus
syllabus.content:
📌 PHYSICS
• Electromagnetic Induction (Complete Chapter)
• Alternating Current (Complete Chapter)
• Electromagnetic Waves (Complete Chapter)
• Ray Optics and Optical Instruments : Introduction of optics, Reflection of light, Reflection from a plane mirror, Refraction of light, Refraction from a plane surface, Total internal refraction,Refraction from curved surface, Combination of lens and power,Newton's formula, Combination of lens and mirror

📌 CHEMISTRY
• Practical Organic Chemistry (Complete Chapter)
• Co-ordination Compound : Definitions of Some Important Terms Pertaining to Coordination Compounds, Classification of Ligands,IUPAC Naming
• Werner Theory & EAN Rule, VBT,CFT

📌 BOTANY
• Principle of Inheritance and Variation (Complete Chapter)
• Microbes in Human Welfare (Complete Chapter)

📌 ZOOLOGY
• Human Health and Diseases (Complete Chapter)
• Biotechnology : Principles And Processes : Introduction
• Principles of biotechnology, Genetic engineering/Recombinant DNA technology, Tools of rDNA technology, Process of rDNA, Isolation of DNA
